description: This file contains utility functions for managing bundle versions, extracting bundles, performing sanity checks on bundle contents, and retrieving package metadata within a specific software project. It is used for handling bundle files, version sorting, and package management in a scripted environment.

methods.name: sortVersions
methods.description: Sorts version strings provided as arguments in version order.

methods.name: getOldestVersion
methods.description: Returns the oldest version from a list of version strings.

methods.name: getLatestVersion
methods.description: Returns the latest version from a list of version strings.

methods.name: getInstalledVersions
methods.description: Retrieves installed versions from given metadata files.

methods.name: getPkgMetadata
methods.description: Fetches package metadata using JSONQUERY for a given file and property.

methods.name: getInstalledPackages
methods.description: Lists installed packages by scanning the RDM_APP_PATH directory.

methods.name: sanityCheckBundle
methods.description: Checks if all required files are present in a bundle directory.

methods.name: extractBundle
methods.description: Extracts a bundle tar file to a specified directory.
